newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan sales tax impact on CPI has faded-EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan sales tax impact on CPI has faded-EPA.

text.p: The impact of Japan's sales tax increase on consumer prices has generally faded, an Economic Planning Agency (EPA) official said on Friday.
"The impact of the consumption tax (increase on consumer prices) has just about all come out," he said.
Tokyo area consumer prices rose 1.4 percent in July from a year earlier, but fell 0.4 percent from the previous month, the Management and Coordination Agency said on Friday.
The EPA official attributed the fall from the previous month to a drop in prices of fresh fruit and vegetables. The prices of such products had risen in June due to cool weather and rain.
Japan's sales tax was raised to five percent from three percent on April 1.
